ideas.name: ETF Flow Stock Reversal
ideas.claim: Stocks with the largest ETF-related outflows outperformed stocks with the largest ETF-related inflows over the following month in the study.
ideas.quote: A trading strategy that buys stocks held by ETFs with extreme outflows and sells stocks held by ETFs with extreme inflows generates a statistically significant four-factor alpha of 7% per annum.
ideas.mechanism: ETF creation and redemption flows are associated with price pressure and subsequent stock-return reversal.

rules.entry: Rank stocks by monthly ETF creation and redemption flows allocated by ETF holdings and normalized by stock market capitalization; buy the lowest decile and short the highest decile.
rules.exit: One month ahead; exact execution time not stated.

not_stated: Exact entry and exit execution times
Point-in-time availability of all required data
Transaction costs for the stock strategy
ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports a one-month-ahead long-short excess return of 61 basis points and four-factor alpha of 60 basis points per month for 2007–2016.
